$comment: Shared remote-submission fixtures, exercised by both language implementations.
ADR-0021 freezes the submission v1 shape and its canonical byte form; this file
is the artefact that keeps the two sides honest. Rust reads it in
crates/app-remote/tests/fixtures.rs and TypeScript reads it in
packages/contracts/tests/submission.test.ts, at run time, so a change cannot be
`canonical` rows pin the exact canonical string and its lowercase SHA-256.
`excluded` rows differ from a canonical row only in a field the hash excludes,
so their hash must equal that row's.
`invalid` rows must be refused by the parser, for the stated reason.
Note *content* rules - size, raw HTML, link schemes - are not duplicated here.
They live in packages/editor/__fixtures__/notes.json and are enforced by
app-core::note, which is the authority for all three write paths.
